questions.question: Who has written the book 'Fearless Governance', published in January 2021, describing her stint as Governor?
questions.questionHtml: Who has written the book 'Fearless Governance', published in January 2021, describing her stint as Governor?
questions.solution: Kiran Bedi, a retired Indian Police Service (IPS) officer, social activist, and former tennis player, authored the book 'Fearless Governance,' published in January 2021. Bedi served as the Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry from 2016 to 2021. The IPS is one of India's three All India Services, providing leaders to state police and central forces, while the Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry oversees the Union Territory's administration. Social activism involves advocating for societal changes to address issues and improve life quality.

Key Points

  • Rangbhoomi (The Arena of Life) is a Hindi language novel by Premchand that features an idealist protagonist inspired by Gandhian values.
  • In this novel of epic proportions set in pre-Independence India, Premchand treads the tricky ground of tensions between the rulers and the ruled.
  • Capturing the travails and traumas of peasant society, Rangbhumi celebrates the unassailable spirit of the common man.
  • Rangbhumi was a product of both personal and political difficulties.
  • The original Hindi novel, published in 1925, was critically acclaimed for its strong characterization and realistic portrayal of the times.
  • Some of the famous works of Munshi Premchand include - Karmabhoomi, Kafan, Godan, Poos Ki Raat, Nirmala, Thakur Ka Kuan, Eidgah, Namak Ka Daroga, etc.

questions.question: The script 'Gurumukhi' for Punjabi language was invented by the Sikh guru ______.
questions.questionHtml: The script 'Gurumukhi' for Punjabi language was invented by the Sikh guru ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Guru Angad.

Key Points

  • Gurumukhi
    • It is the name of the official script used in writing primarily Punjabi.
    • It was invented by the Guru Angad.
    • Its direction is from left to right.
    • The primary scripture of Sikhism the Guru Granth Sahib is written in Gurmukhi.
  • Guru Angad
    • He was the second Guru of the ten Sikhs gurus of Sikhism.

Additional Information

  • Guru Nanak was the founder of Sikhism and the first guru of Sikhism
  • Guru Gobind Singh was the last guru of Sikhism.
  • Guru Ram, the fourth guru founded the city of Amritsar.
  • Guru Arjan, the fifth guru built the Golden Tempe and compiled the holy Granth Sahib.
    • He was the first great martyr in Sikh History when he was executed under Jahangir's order.
  • Guru Har Krishan Sahib, the eighth guru was the youngest guru. He became a guru when he was five
  • Guru Tegh Bahadur was executed under Aurangzeb's orders.

questions.question: Which of the following novel is written by Bhisham Sahni?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following novel is written by Bhisham Sahni?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Tamas.

Key Points

  • Tamas
    • Bhisham Sahni's book Tamas is based on the riots he witnessed while living in Rawalpindi during India's 1947 Partition.
    • Tamas illustrates the atrocities of senseless communal politics of hostility and hatred as well as their sad results including death, destruction, forced migration, and nation-splitting.
    • It has been translated into a variety of Indian languages, including Tamil, Gujarati, Malayalam, Kashmiri, and Manipuri.
    • In 1975, Tamas won the Sahitya Akademi Award for Literature, and in 1987, Govind Nihalani made a television movie out of it.

Additional Information

  • Bhisham Sahni 
    • Bhisham Sahni was an Indian novelist, actor, and playwright.
    • He was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Fellowship in 2002 and the Padma Bhushan for literature in 1998.
    • He was Balraj Sahni's younger brother, a well-known Hindi film actor. 
    • He was the founder and chairman of "SAHMAT," an organisation dedicated to promoting intercultural understanding and named for the murdered activist and theatre artist Safdar Hashmi.

questions.question: Matthew Hayden, former Australian cricketer, has written which of the following autobiographies?
questions.questionHtml: Matthew Hayden, former Australian cricketer, has written which of the following autobiographies?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Standing My Ground.

Key Points

  • Standing My Ground is the autobiography of former Australian cricketer Matthew Hayden.
  • In this book, Matthew Hayden provides insights into his cricketing career and personal life.
  • The autobiography covers his journey from being a young cricketer to becoming one of the leading batsmen in the world.
  • It also reflects on the challenges, triumphs, and the mental and physical demands of being a professional cricketer.

Additional Information

  • Autobiography
    • An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of oneself. It is a personal narrative that offers insights into the life, experiences, and thoughts of the author.
    • Autobiographies are an important literary genre and can provide firsthand perspectives on historical events, personal achievements, and social issues.
  • Matthew Hayden
    • Matthew Hayden is a former Australian cricketer who was known for his aggressive batting style and remarkable performances in international cricket.
    • He played as an opening batsman for the Australian national team and had a successful career spanning from 1994 to 2009.
    • Hayden has several records to his name, including the highest individual test score by an Australian, which he achieved with a score of 380 runs against Zimbabwe in 2003.
  • Other Autobiographies

questions.question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Shadow Lines'?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Shadow Lines'?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is "Amitav Ghosh".

Important Points

  • Renowned English fiction writer Amitav Ghosh has been selected for the Jnanpith award, 2018.
  • This has been announced by Jnanpith Selection Board on 14 December 2018.
  • Amitav Ghosh was born in Calcutta in 1956.
  • He is an alumnus of Doon School, Dehradun, St. Stephen’s College, Delhi University and Delhi School of Economics.
  • He was awarded Padma Shri in 2007 and was elected as Fellow of the Royal Society of Literature in 2009.
  • He was also named Ford Foundation Art of Change Fellow in 2015.


His works :

  • The Circle of Reason (1986) was his first novel.
  • Other fiction works include  The Shadow Lines (1988), The Calcutta Chromosome (1995), The Glass Palace (2000), The Hungry Tide (2004).
  • He has also written three works as a part of The Ibis trilogy of which the first volume is Sea of Poppies (2008); the second volume is River of Smoke (2011), and the third volume is Flood of Fire (2015).
  • His notable non-fiction works include Antique Land (1992), Dancing in Cambodia and at Large in Burma (1998), Countdown (1999), and The Imam and the Indian (2002), The Great Derangement: Climate Change and the Unthinkable (2016).

 

Additional Information

  • Jnanpith award was instituted in 1961.
  • Via this award, the Bhartiya Jnanpith recognizes Indian litterateurs who write in one of the 22 Indian languages listed in Schedule Eight of the Indian Constitution.
  • The winners receive a cash prize, a citation and a bronze replica of Goddess Saraswati.
  • Famous Malayalam writer G.S. Kurup was the first winner of the Jnanpith award.
